name: write_two_digit_counter_text
description: Writes a counter as two decimal digit characters into two fixed text positions, then calls a helper routine twice, setting a control global to a different value before each call.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:4094
name: copy_table_until_sentinel
description: Calls exec permit and forbid helpers, then selects a data block from a pointer table by a counter and copies words from it into a global area until a sentinel of minus 99 appears. It then writes a fixed value into four words, resets several state globals and calls helpers.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:4286
name: reset_keyboard_state_byte
description: Rotates a global byte by combining it shifted left by seven with it shifted right by one, then inverts the result. It then overwrites the byte with zero and then with the constant 136. Its hardware references include the keyboard control and serial registers.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:42E0
name: invert_rotated_global_byte
description: Combines a global byte shifted left by seven with the same byte shifted right by one, then inverts the result and stores it back into the global.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:42F2
name: reset_state_flags
description: If one counter global is above sixteen and so is a second, or the second is three while the first is not, it clears two globals and returns. Otherwise it copies the first counter into the second, calls a helper, and clears four globals.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:4376
name: load_hardware_channel_from_table
description: Looks up several values in a table at an index derived from the input word, writes a pointer and a few values into hardware channel registers, sets a state global, and clears bookkeeping globals.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:4414
name: decrement_counters_and_set_flag
description: Decrements four counters in memory. When each reaches zero it stores a distinct value (one, two, four or eight) into a global. When the last counter reaches zero it also clears two globals, and that counter is clamped at zero.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:447A
name: step_counters_toward_limits
description: Adds an accumulator into a counter and clears it, then steps two counters toward zero or toward a maximum of 83, calling helpers on each step. It clears flags along the way and returns the value of a global after the updates.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:45DE
name: copy_state_and_derive_value
description: Copies four source globals into four destination globals, then stores a derived value: the third source global plus 6400, shifted right by six, minus 100.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:461E
name: reset_and_sync_position_step
description: Clears four globals. If a position global is not below minus thirty-two, it computes a scaled position and compares it with the stored one. When the difference is exactly one step it stores the new value and calls a helper, then sets a flag and runs another helper before clearing a final global.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:4728
name: classify_signed_offset
description: Classifies a signed offset global into a small code. The code is two for a large nonnegative offset or a small offset while a counter is zero, one for a large negative offset, and zero otherwise. A large nonnegative offset also clears a flag.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:4774
name: find_nearest_table_entry
description: Scans a table of entries that ends at a sentinel of 99, comparing each entry's coordinates with a reference position and keeping the nearest match within a starting distance limit. It stores the best entry in globals and calls helpers when a match is found.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:4B94
name: compute_first_axis_offset
description: Reads a low nibble from a record through a pointer, takes the absolute difference between two coordinates, and looks up a value at that difference in a table. It stores a sign-adjusted value scaled from a global and a second global, divided by fifteen, then calls a helper.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:4BF8
name: compute_second_axis_offset
description: Reads a low nibble from a record through a pointer, takes the absolute difference between two coordinates, and looks up a value at that difference in a table. It stores a sign-adjusted value scaled from a global and a second global, divided by fifteen, into the second axis slot, then calls a helper.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:4C5E
name: scale_global_by_table_entry
description: If a record's low nibble equals three and a flag is clear, halves a global and sets the flag. It then sets another global to one and stores a value scaled from that global, a value read through a pointer, and a third global, divided by seven.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:4CBC
name: initialize_and_loop_ten_steps
description: Clears and sets a few globals and calls a helper. It then waits for a busy flag to clear, decrements a wrapping counter, calls three helpers and sets a flag, repeating ten times before entering an endless wait loop.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:4D86
name: countdown_nine_steps_then_spin
description: Sets a global to one and calls helpers, then waits for a busy flag to clear. It runs a countdown of ten passes that wrap a counter and call helpers, sets a flag on each pass, and spins forever at the end.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:4E2A
name: set_global_five_and_call
description: Stores five into a global byte and calls one helper routine, then returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:4E88
name: update_entity_state_codes
description: Handles one record's state codes. Several specific codes change counters, flags or table entries, and a record whose state is negative has its recent position written into an eight-entry ring buffer. It then calls helpers that set feedback values.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:5300
name: dispatch_entity_action_codes
description: Dispatches on a record's action code. Several codes change counters and flags, one places the record at a stepped height taken from a range table, and the routine calls helpers for each match.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:54CC
name: update_entity_velocity_effects
description: Handles a record's action code, then selects a feedback code from the magnitude of a velocity global, capped at 63, and calls helpers. A large velocity also adjusts a counter and an effect value.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:56AC
name: mark_entity_and_update_velocity
description: Writes a marker value into the record first, then handles its action code with the same velocity adjustment and feedback selection, calling helpers as it goes.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:5744
name: update_entity_velocity_from_pointer
description: Handles the record addressed by a pointer global with the same velocity adjustment, action-code handling and feedback selection, calling helpers as it goes.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:58A0
name: clamp_scaled_magnitude_flags
description: Computes an absolute value from a global scaled by eight or by two depending on a type value, clamps it at 63, and either clears two globals or stores the result and calls a helper. Further helpers are called depending on flag values.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:5972
name: copy_glyph_rows_to_text
description: For each of 16 characters, looks up a glyph pointer through a table indexed by the character, with space mapped to its own index. It then copies 16 rows of two words each into two planes of a text buffer, advancing by a 40-byte stride.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:5A00
name: move_record_and_check_tiles
description: Advances a record's vertical position by its velocity. When it crosses a block boundary it looks up matching table entries for the record's kind, and on a match it snaps the record to the boundary and applies kind-specific counter and velocity changes.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:5C2A
name: set_idle_state_when_clear
description: If two counters are both zero, stores eleven into a state global and sixty-three into another, then calls one helper. Otherwise it returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:5C60
name: check_record_proximity_and_react
description: Compares a record with a reference position and returns early unless it is close, using a squared-distance limit of 900 and a height window. When it is close it applies kind-specific counter changes and calls helpers. Kind seven clears two words when its timer is not positive.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:5F32
name: append_marker_entries_to_list
description: Adds 500 to a counter and calls a helper. It then finds the end of a list terminated by -999 and writes four blocks of entries built from the position globals, with mirrored offsets, followed by a terminator.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:600A
name: process_nearby_record_hit
description: When a flag is clear and a record's kind is not one or below, checks whether its squared distance to a reference point is under 485. On a match it applies a kind-specific counter change, halves three velocity values and calls helpers.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6118
name: update_record_table_until_sentinel
description: Walks a table of records until it reaches the sentinel entry. For each record it reads the kind field, moves the position by its velocity, decrements a counter with a floor, and calls helpers chosen by the kind.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:627A
name: shift_list_entries_down
description: Shifts each two-word entry of a sentinel-terminated list back by a fixed number of slots, starting at an offset, until it reaches the terminator. It then writes the sentinel into the vacated slot.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:62A4
name: adjust_record_motion_words
description: Returns early if a global flag is set. Otherwise it nudges two motion words of a record toward a reference point by a step taken from the record's kind, decays both toward zero, and clamps a third counter with a floor.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:63E0
name: update_position_with_direction_mask
description: Adds velocity values to two position accumulators, moves them by a step chosen from a four-bit direction mask, and damps them toward zero while a timer is active. It also clamps a separate velocity value.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:662C
name: return_without_work
description: Does nothing and returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:662E
name: call_helper_then_six_calls
description: Calls one helper routine, then calls six more helper routines when a flag global is zero.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6656
name: pack_tile_bytes_into_words
description: Builds 16-bit words from pairs of bytes at four plane offsets in a source table, selecting rows with two index values derived from a global. It writes the words into two destination tables over eight rows.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:66F2
name: call_helper_five_times
description: Calls one helper routine five times in succession and returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6762
name: copy_planar_rows_with_terminators
description: Copies sixteen entries from a table selected by an input index into two destination buffers, writing words from three plane offsets in an interleaved pattern. It ends the buffers with a zero word and an all-ones long.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:67B6
name: call_helper_if_counter_positive
description: Calls one helper routine only when a counter global is positive, then returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:67F0
name: call_helper_if_counter_positive
description: Calls one helper routine only when a counter global is positive, then returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:682A
name: call_helper_if_counter_positive
description: Calls one helper routine only when a counter global is positive, then returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6864
name: call_helper_if_counter_positive
description: Calls one helper routine only when a counter global is positive, then returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:689E
name: wait_for_helper_result_one
description: If a counter global is positive, calls a helper repeatedly until it returns one, then returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:68E0
name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper routine and returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:68F2
name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper routine and returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6904
name: wait_for_helper_result_one
description: Calls a helper repeatedly until it returns one, then returns zero.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:692E
name: wait_for_helper_result_one
description: If a counter global is positive, calls a helper repeatedly until it returns one, then returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6970
name: copy_four_words_by_index
description: Copies four 16-bit words from a source table into two destination buffers at an offset computed from an input index. It first advances the source by a fixed amount when it points at one specific table and the index is below 28.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:69CA
name: wait_for_helper_result_one
description: Calls a helper repeatedly until it returns one, then returns zero.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:69DC
name: copy_rows_with_blank_fill
description: Copies 14 rows of four words from a source table into two destination tables at a row offset derived from an input index. When the index exceeds one less than a global value, it writes zero and all-ones words into those entries instead.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6A8C
name: call_helper_twice_if_nonnegative
description: If a counter global is zero or positive, calls one helper twice. Otherwise it returns without action.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6AF2
name: clear_words_with_flag_branch
description: When a flag global is zero, calls helpers, sets the high bit in two words and clears four words. Otherwise it clears the four words directly.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6BD0
name: fill_or_copy_entry_block
description: If a flag global is set, fills 200 entries with a sentinel value and zeroes four trailing words. Otherwise it copies a counted number of entries from a source table and zeroes the same four trailing words.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6BDA
name: copy_counted_entries_then_clear
description: Copies a counted number of entries from a source table into a destination, advancing the source by twenty words each time, then zeroes four trailing long words.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6C40
name: pack_two_bytes_and_flag
description: Writes a word that packs one input's shifted low byte with a second input's low byte as its high byte. It then writes a flag word of 62208 with small bits set from both inputs.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6C72
name: initialize_four_state_words
description: Writes minus forty-five, twenty, one and zero into four consecutive state words, then returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6C94
name: initialize_tables_and_scan_entries
description: Clears several globals and calls helpers, then sets pointer globals to table addresses. It scans a fixed table of entries, counting specific kinds and tallying the rest, and records values for later use.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6F18
name: decode_bytes_into_entries
description: Splits a 32-bit value into four bytes. For each nonzero byte it writes a four-word entry derived from the byte's bits, followed by sentinel words, and advances through the table for each byte.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6F76
name: copy_words_until_marker
description: Copies 16-bit words within a global area until it copies the value minus 99, then calls one helper routine.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6F94
name: copy_entries_with_zeroed_fields
description: Copies eight-word entries from a global table until the sentinel minus 999 appears. Each copy keeps the first four words and zeroes the next four, then the routine writes the sentinel and the final three words.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:6FC6
name: return_without_work
description: Does nothing and returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:7000
name: scan_table_for_masked_matches
description: Calls helpers, then runs 16 passes over a sentinel-terminated table in a global area. Each pass looks for entries whose masked value matches a masked position value, calling a helper on each match and again when the position matches.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:70A6
name: update_collision_parameters
description: When a record's kind and a counter allow it and its vertical offset lies in a fixed window, derives two scaled values from the position globals and a table entry. It computes a clamped size value from a division, stores these as globals, and calls a helper.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:7162
name: select_and_test_entry_bounds
description: Selects a lookup table based on a kind field in a record and on flags, reads entries from it, and scales two signed offsets from the record. It checks the resulting coordinates against bounds, calling helpers on the way, and on success stores a pointer and updates flags.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:74DC
name: set_event_code_by_kind
description: Sets an event code from a kind value when a counter or flag allows it, and computes a distance-based value from a record's offset. It calls a helper if that value is nonnegative, then clears the event code.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:755C
name: advance_frame_from_offset
description: Chooses a step from a signed offset global and the differences between successive table entries, then calls helpers several times to advance a frame counter. Negative offsets take a different path from nonnegative ones.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:76D8
name: check_table_window_and_flag
description: When a counter is nonnegative and a flag is clear, looks up a value in a table at an index taken from a global, then adds an offset and constant. If the result falls in a fixed window it sets a global to one and returns, otherwise it calls a helper.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:7774
name: find_positive_entry_then_set
description: Scans five words of a global area for the first positive value. If it finds one it stores five into a global and calls one helper routine.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:77F8
name: set_global_when_nonnegative
description: If a signed global value is zero or positive, stores five into another global and calls one helper routine. Otherwise it returns without doing anything.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:786A
name: update_counters_and_state_flags
description: Returns early when a flag is set. Otherwise it updates several counters and timers, clamping and decrementing them, selects a table entry for the current index, and calls helpers in several branches chosen by comparisons.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:7D62
name: set_event_code_and_call
description: When a flag is clear and a counter is nonnegative, sets event code 19 with value 60 if another counter is low. It then stores five into a global and calls one helper routine.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:7E04
name: set_global_five_and_call
description: Stores five into a global byte and calls one helper routine, then returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:7E6A
name: set_global_five_and_call
description: Stores five into a global byte and calls one helper routine, then returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:7EC2
name: set_global_five_and_call
description: Stores five into a global byte and calls one helper routine, then returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:7F1A
name: toggle_flag_and_set_step
description: Sets a velocity-like global to ten, toggles a flag global, and when the flag becomes nonzero sets that global to minus ten.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:7F34
name: adjust_and_apply_damped_offset
description: Nudges a signed global toward zero by small steps, depending on the sign of a second global, then stores the result back and adds it to a third. When a flag is zero it also subtracts a scaled fraction of that third global.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:7F98
name: toggle_and_cycle_counter
description: When a flag is clear, toggles a global and, if the toggle becomes zero, calls helpers in a pattern set by a counter that cycles from one to seven.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8002
name: map_text_chars_to_glyphs
description: Walks 22 characters of a text string, mapping each to an index with a special value for a space. For odd indices it sets a mask of minus eight, then stores a constant and calls a helper for each character, advancing an offset by eight.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8094
name: advance_object_state_and_lookup
description: Advances a state pointer through a four-word sequence, copying its values into position globals and a sign-adjusted offset. It calls helpers under some conditions and returns an identifier looked up in a table indexed by the current state.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:821A
name: call_helper_for_five_rows
description: Calls one helper five times, each time with a base address advanced by 8000 bytes, a counter counting down from five, and a fixed constant.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8252
name: call_helper_store_five_between
description: Calls one helper, stores five into a global byte, then calls the helper again before returning.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:82A2
name: select_window_index_and_call
description: Derives a value from a velocity global and checks it against two fixed windows. When the window conditions hold it picks a clamped index, calls a helper with a global set to five, and returns the index.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:834A
name: set_global_when_above_two
description: If a velocity-like global is greater than two, stores five into another global and calls one helper. It then clears a third global.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:83C0
name: set_global_repeat_if_flagged
description: Stores five into a global byte and calls one helper. If a flag is nonzero it repeats the store and call, then clears the flag.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8468
name: store_global_and_mark_table
description: Stores a register value into a global, then writes all-ones into a long at a fixed offset from a table pointer.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:84C8
name: scale_and_clamp_offsets
description: Computes two scaled values from globals and divides them by an adjusted distance, storing the results in globals. It also computes a divisor from the constant 2975 divided by that distance, capped at 24, and derives two offsets from it before calling a helper.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8548
name: append_entry_to_sentinel_table
description: Finds the sentinel-terminated end of a table and writes a new four-word entry there, using position values from a pointer argument and a constant offset. It fills the following slots with sentinels, increments a counter and, when that counter reaches two, resets a second counter and copies values from the argument into several globals.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8664
name: append_typed_entry_to_table
description: When a flag is clear, sets a state global and writes a new entry at the sentinel end of a table. Its position comes from a record's coordinates shifted by five, and two velocity-like fields are set from the record's type code before the entry is ended with sentinels.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8778
name: spawn_record_into_table
description: When a record's kind is below six and a flag is clear, claims the first sentinel slot in a table. It fills in the position from the record's coordinates shifted by five, plus orientation and type fields, and computes a distance-based counter. Otherwise it only updates a counter from the record's offset.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8958
name: process_command_word_list
description: Reads 16-bit command words from a pointer until it reaches a negative word, skipping marker words. It dispatches on each command's low six bits to adjust globals and call helpers, and sets a flag when any command was handled.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8CA4
name: stub_index_comparison_no_effect
description: Computes a value from a word argument and compares the input word with it. Both branches return without changing anything, so the routine has no visible effect.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8CCE
name: return_difference_from_offset
description: Returns the input word minus a value derived from a second register offset by nineteen. Both branches return the same difference.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8CE0
name: stub_sum_check_no_effect
description: Compares two signed inputs for being exact opposites and for their sum being nonnegative, then returns in every case without changing anything.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8D00
name: stub_scaled_compare_no_effect
description: Computes a scaled quotient from a global and a register value, then compares a register input with it. Both branches return, so the routine makes no change.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8D4E
name: stub_threshold_compare_no_effect
description: Compares a register input with a threshold formed from another register minus 199. Both paths return without effect.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8D60
name: stub_quotient_compare_no_effect
description: Divides an adjusted register value by an unsigned divisor and compares the result with an input. Both paths return without any effect.

name: return_without_work
description: Does nothing and returns, ending immediately without touching memory or registers.

name: save_registers_to_globals
description: Copies the data and address register values into a block of globals in sequence, then returns.

description: Copies the data and address register values into a block of globals in sequence, then returns.

name: save_registers_to_globals
description: Copies the data and address register values into a block of globals in sequence, then returns.

name: read_eight_bytes_through_pointer
description: Reads an eight-byte value through the address register pointer and returns it.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8DE2
name: wrap_angle_and_advance_frame
description: Subtracts a sum of two globals from an angle counter and wraps it into the range zero to 359. It advances a frame counter, runs a small state machine on flags, calls helpers, decrements a timer, and returns a value.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8F3A
name: allocate_and_initialize_game
description: Allocates a memory block through the exec library and halts if the allocation fails. Otherwise it runs a start-up sequence that clears a 300000-byte block, sets up a table of pointers and calls helpers.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8F46
name: generate_lfsr_bitmask
description: Advances a global seed eight times, doubling it on each step and setting its low bit when the doubled and original values differ in sign. It collects one bit per step into a mask, stores the last seed value, and returns the mask.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8F82
name: scramble_record_word_bits
description: Reads a word at a fixed offset of a record pointed to by an address register, mixes its bits with a shifted copy of itself, and returns a byte built from the result.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8F8A
name: scramble_record_word_bits
description: Reads a word at a second fixed offset of a record pointed to by an address register, mixes its bits with a shifted copy of itself, and returns the low byte.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:8FA8
name: clear_long_pool_block
description: Calls one helper, then zeroes a large block of longs starting at a fixed offset from a global base, over 19 unrolled passes.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:903E
name: copy_two_blocks_to_globals
description: Copies five consecutive longs from one pointer argument into five globals, and five longs from a second pointer argument into five more globals.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9060
name: set_display_window_registers
description: Writes fixed values to the display window start and stop registers, the bitplane control and modulo registers, and the data fetch registers, then returns.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:90A0
name: repeat_calls_then_reset_globals
description: Calls a helper once for each step of a global value counting down to zero, then clears one global and writes fixed values into three others.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:912E
name: set_record_fields_from_flags
description: Calls a helper, then writes several fields of a record pointed to by an address register. Values come from flag bits in a register and from globals, and two fields are set to all-ones or zero depending on those bits.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:91B8
name: wait_for_dma_status_clear
description: Spins reading a DMA status byte until bit six is clear, then returns. It performs no other work.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:91D2
name: repeat_calls_then_clear_globals
description: Calls a helper once for each step of a global value counting down to zero. It then clears one global, writes 4042 into another, and clears a third.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:925A
name: initialize_record_fields_from_flags
description: Calls a helper, then writes fields of a record through an address register. It masks a table word with flag bits from a register and a global, and stores two fields computed from a value returned by the helper.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:92E2
name: set_blitter_registers_from_result
description: Calls a helper and writes its two returned values into blitter pointer registers. It then clears several blitter registers and writes a size-derived value, built from the helper's short result, to the blitter control register.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9324
name: clear_global_long_table
description: Calls a helper, then zeroes ten longs per pass for 200 passes over a global table, covering 2000 longs in total.
